description_en: Binds an AXB intermediate number to establish a one-to-one relationship, allowing User A and User B to contact each other through the intermediate number X
description_zh: AXB中间号，是将拨打关系限定在一对一关系中，用户A可以通过中间号码X联系到用户B，用户B也可以通过中间号码X联系到用户A
name: BindAxb

parameters.help_en:
The key of the number pool.

You can obtain the number pool key on the Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool) page in the Phone Number privacy protection console
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面获取号码池Key
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en:
Number A of the AXB intermediate number.

Number A can be a mobile phone number or a landline number. For a landline number, include the area code without a hyphen between the area code and the landline number.
If your business requires modifying a bound number, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110253.html operation. You can bind or unbind numbers in the console, but modifying bound numbers is not supported in the console
parameters.help_zh:
AXB中间号的A号码。

A号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话请加区号，区号和固定电话之间不需要连字符。
如果您的业务需要修改已绑定的号码，可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110253.html接口进行修改，控制台可以绑定或解绑号码，暂时不支持修改已绑定的号码
parameters.name: phone_noa

parameters.help_en:
Number B of the AXB intermediate number.

Number B can be a mobile phone number or a landline number. For a landline number, include the area code without a hyphen between the area code and the landline number.
If your business requires modifying a bound number, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110253.html operation. You can bind or unbind numbers in the console, but modifying bound numbers is not supported in the console
parameters.help_zh:
AXB中间号的B号码。

B号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话请加区号，区号和固定电话中间不需要连字符。
如果您的业务需要修改已绑定的号码，可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110253.html接口进行修改，控制台可以绑定或解绑号码，暂时不支持修改已绑定的号码
parameters.name: phone_nob

parameters.help_en:
Number X of the AXB intermediate number.

Number X is a private number that you have purchased (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy) in the console.

If you do not specify Number X, the system randomly selects a number from the specified number pool based on the ExpectCity parameter value as Number X.
If the specified number pool does not have a Number X in the specified city, or if the ExpectCity parameter is not specified, the system randomly assigns a number from another city in the specified number pool as Number X.
If the Number X allocation mode is set to strict match mode, the system assigns a number from the city to which Number A belongs by default. If no number is available in that city, the binding fails. For more information about the number allocation mode, see Configure a number pool (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/pnp/user-guide/manage-phone-number-pools#section-st9-xl1-l3c)
parameters.help_zh:
AXB中间号的X号码。

X号码是您在控制台已购买的隐私号 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy)。

如果您未填写X号码，系统会根据ExpectCity参数值从指定号码池中随机选择一个号码作为X号码。
如果当前号码池中没有该城市的X号码，或未填写ExpectCity参数值，系统会从指定号码池中随机分配一个其他城市的号码作为X号码。
如果X号码分配模式配置为严格匹配模式，默认分配A号码所属城市号码，如果该城市无号码，返回绑定号码失败。号码分配模式操作请参见配置号码池 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/user-guide/manage-phone-number-pools?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.689e7d22cbD4Um#section-st9-xl1-l3c)
parameters.name: phone_nox

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time of the number binding.

The expiration time must be at least 1 minute later than the current binding time, accurate to seconds.
You can manually unbind the numbers at any time before the binding expires.
If you unbind the numbers during an active call, the current call is not affected
parameters.help_zh:
号码绑定的过期时间。

必须晚于当前绑定时间1分钟以上，时间精确到秒。
号码绑定过期时间内，您可随时进行手动解绑。
若您对正在通话中的号码进行解绑，不会影响本次通话
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en:
The specified city for selecting Number X.

If the specified number pool does not have a Number X in the specified city, or if the ExpectCity parameter is not specified, the system randomly assigns a number from another city in the specified number pool as Number X.
If the Number X allocation mode is set to strict match mode, the system assigns a number from the city to which Number A belongs by default. If no number is available in that city, the binding fails. For more information about the number allocation mode, see Configure a number pool (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/pnp/user-guide/manage-phone-number-pools#section-st9-xl1-l3c)
parameters.help_zh:
指定城市进行X号码的选号。

如果当前号码池中没有该城市的X号码，或未填写ExpectCity参数值，系统会从指定号码池中随机分配一个其他城市的号码作为X号码。
如果X号码分配模式配置为严格匹配模式，即默认分配A号码所属城市号码，如果该城市无号码，返回绑定号码失败。号码分配模式操作请参见配置号码池 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/user-guide/manage-phone-number-pools?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.689e7d22cbD4Um#section-st9-xl1-l3c)
parameters.name: expect_city

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the call recording feature. Valid values:

true: Enables call recording.
false: Disables call recording. This is the default value.

After you enable the call recording feature, you can play and download voice files in the call records. Recording files are billed at CNY 0.010 per minute
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启通话录音功能。取值：

true：录音。
false：不录音（默认值）。

开启通话录音功能后，可在呼叫记录中播放和下载语音文件。录音文件按通话分钟计费0.010元/分钟
parameters.name: is_recording_enabled

parameters.help_en: The external business extension field. This parameter is returned in the receipt message of the call record
parameters.help_zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the single call restriction. Valid values:

CONTROL_AX_DISABLE: Number A cannot call Number X.
CONTROL_BX_DISABLE: Number B cannot call Number X
parameters.help_zh:
单次呼叫限制的状态。取值：

CONTROL_AX_DISABLE：A号码无法呼叫X号码。
CONTROL_BX_DISABLE：B号码无法呼叫X号码
parameters.name: call_restrict

parameters.help_en:
The number display logic in the binding relationship. Set the value to 1, which indicates that both the caller and the callee see the intermediate Number X.

Due to carrier regulatory restrictions, the setting to display the real number during a call does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
重置绑定关系中的号码显示逻辑。固定取值1，即主叫和被叫显示中间号码X。

由于运营商监管限制，呼叫时显示真实号码的设置不生效
parameters.name: call_display_type

parameters.help_en:
The color ringtone configuration. After the AXB intermediate number is attached, this parameter specifies the enterprise color ringtone played when Number X is called. You must specify the ringtone field and the color ringtone encoding for this parameter.

Ringtone fields:
AXBRing_A: The ringtone Settings before Number A calls Number X and the call is connected.
AXBRing_B: The ringtone Settings before Number B calls Number X and the call is connected.
AXBRing_A_PICKUP: The ringtone Settings after Number A calls Number X and the call is connected.
AXBRing_B_PICKUP: The ringtone Settings after Number B calls Number X and the call is connected.

Color ringtone encoding: You can obtain the enterprise color ringtone encoding on the Enterprise Color Ringtone Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool/ringtone?resType=1) page in the Phone Number privacy protection console.

Example: To set the ringtone before Number B calls Number X and the call is connected, enter "AXBRing_B": "1000****1".

The enterprise color ringtone configured at the attachment level takes precedence. If it is not configured or does not take effect, the color ringtone configured at the number pool level is used
parameters.help_zh:
彩铃配置，AXB中间号号码绑定后，拨打X号码的企业彩铃；此参数请填写铃音字段和彩铃编码。

铃音字段如下：
A号码拨打X接通前的铃音设置：AXBRing_A
B号码拨打X接通前的铃音设置：AXBRing_B
A号码拨打X接通后的铃音设置：AXBRing_A_PICKUP
B号码拨打X接通后的铃音设置：AXBRing_B_PICKUP

彩铃编码：在号码隐私保护控制台企业彩铃管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool/ringtone?resType=1)页面获取企业彩铃编码。

填写示例： 如设置B号码拨打X接通前的铃音，填写："AXBRing_B": "1000****1"。

企业彩铃优先使用绑定级别设置的彩铃，如果未设置或设置未生效，则会使用号码池级别的彩铃音
parameters.name: ring_config

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) feature. Valid values:

false: Disables the ASR feature. This is the default value.
true: Enables the ASR feature.

After you enable this feature, speech in a call can be converted to text. You can obtain the text content along with the recording file. You can download the speech-to-text results in the call records. The text results are billed at CNY 0.060 per minute
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启ASR服务功能。取值：

false：关闭（默认值）。
true：开启。

开通功能后，可以将通话中的语音转为文本，获取录音文件同时可获取文本内容。可在呼叫记录中下载语音文本。 文本结果按通话分钟计费，ASR费用0.060元/分钟
parameters.name: asr_status

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the ASR model. Valid values:

7ee372834d2f4cc7ac0d0ab2d0ae1aac: General-Telephone-Mandarin Chinese model ID.

9b4afe3d224e4fa3bf963697113e2f77: General-Telephone-Cantonese model ID.

3655a6cb94764145a1f9a38a3c3b3b4b: General-Telephone-Regional Accent model ID
parameters.help_zh:
ASR模型ID。取值：

通用-电话-中文普通话模型ID：7ee372834d2f4cc7ac0d0ab2d0ae1aac

通用-电话-中文粤语模型ID：9b4afe3d224e4fa3bf963697113e2f77

通用-电话-地方口音模型ID：3655a6cb94764145a1f9a38a3c3b3b4b
parameters.name: asr_model_id

parameters.help_en: The ringback duration. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 5 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 顺振时长。单位：秒。取值范围为5~20
parameters.name: call_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The Dual-Tone Multi-Frequency (DTMF) key configuration. This parameter is used when binding an AXB intermediate number. You can configure the following items:
endCallIvrPhoneNo: The playback target, Number A or Number B.
waitingDtmfTime: The maximum waiting duration after the first audio file is played. The maximum duration is 30 seconds.
maxLoop  dtmf: The maximum number of times the first audio file is looped when the key press does not match. The maximum number of loops is 5.
step1File: The name of the first audio file.
step2File: The name of the second audio file.
validKey: The valid key values. For example, 1,2 allows only two valid key values, separated by a comma (,).
waitingEndCall: The carrier hang-up waiting duration. The maximum waiting duration is 10 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
dtmf按键配置，设置AXB中间号号码绑定时使用，可配置内容如下：
endCallIvrPhoneNo：放音对象A或B。
waitingDtmfTime：放完第一段音后的最大等待时长，最大时长为30秒。
maxLoop  dtmf：按键不匹配，循环播放第一个放音文件的最大次数，最大循环次数为5次。
step1File：第一个放音文件名称。
step2File：第二个放音文件名称。
validKey：合法按键值定义，如：1,2只允许配置两个有效键值，用","分隔。
waitingEndCall：运营商挂机等待时长，最大等待时长为10秒
parameters.name: dtmf_config

A value of OK indicates that the request is successful.
For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

SecretBindDTO.description_zh: 号码绑定成功后返回的结构体

Extension.description_zh: 接口BindAxb不涉及此参数，请忽略该返回参数

SecretNo.description_en: The purchased private number, which is Number X
SecretNo.description_zh: 已购买的隐私号码，即X号码

SubsId.description_en:
The number binding ID.

You can use the returned number binding ID to call the QuerySubscriptionDetail (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-querysubscriptiondetail) operation to query the details of the number binding
SubsId.description_zh:
号码绑定ID。

您可以用返回的号码绑定ID，调用QuerySubscriptionDetail (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-querysubscriptiondetail?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.122b4d02RB4KDs)接口，查询号码绑定详情
